subject: Partner discovery — action plan & slotting
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimcloud.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0500
Subject: Quick recap + request: technical deep-dive

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — good to meet the team. Quick recap from NimbusCloud's side and a request to get a technical deep-dive on the calendar:

Highlights from our side:
- Goal: list Nimbus-managed connectors on Redwood Marketplace and support partner-billed subscriptions.
- Key non-negotiables: SAML SSO, per-tenant logging/export, and clear SLA for inference latency under 200ms for typical batch sizes.
- Timeline: pilot with two customers by end of Q1 2027.

What we'd like next:
1) A 60–75 minute technical deep-dive to align on API/manifest requirements, deployment topology, and security evidence (SOC2 scopes + logging hooks).
2) A short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines owners and milestones — we have a template attached for reference.

Attendees from our side: me (partnerships), Anika Patel (technical program manager), and one architect (TBD).

Proposed weeks: week of Nov 15 or Nov 22. Flexible on day — we prefer mornings PST. Can you share 2–3 slots that work for Redwood's solutions engineers?

Attached: Nimbus-MAP-v1.xlsx (sample).

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, NimbusCloud
liam.oconnor@nimcloud.com
[Attachment: Nimbus-MAP-v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick recap + request: technical deep-dive

Thanks Liam — great conversation. Short recap from our side, suggested owners, and three concrete slots to pick from.

Recap / owners:
- Redwood goals: make marketplace listing work end-to-end + ensure predictable inference economics for Nimbus customers.
- Owners: Jonas Weber (alliances, commercial owner), Camila Reyes (partner solutions engineer, technical owner), Marissa Cole (product lead for marketplace).

Suggested agenda for the 60–75 minute deep-dive:
- 5m introductions & objectives
- 15m high-level marketplace listing/flow (Marissa)
- 30m technical deep-dive: API schema, auth (SAML/OAuth), billing hooks, logging/export (Camila + Anika)
- 10m integration risks and success criteria
- 5–10m next steps / MAP ownership

Proposed slots (all times PST):
- Tue Nov 16 — 10:00–11:15am PST
- Wed Nov 17 — 09:00–10:15am PST
- Thu Nov 18 — 01:00–02:15pm PST

If one of those works, we'll send an invite and attach a short pre-read (topology + MAP).

I've attached a Redwood MAP template and our topology PDF for their engineer to review. Also linking the HubSpot deal and a shared Drive with our integration checklist.

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear agenda and slots. Confirming Wed Nov 17, 09:00–10:15am PST works for Nimbus (that lines up with our engineer and security lead).

Quick asks ahead of the session:
- Can you share a short topology diagram and example manifest for the marketplace listing (Camila's topology PDF looked helpful — if you can confirm final version by EOD Nov 12 that'd be great).
- Our security lead will want to see the specific logging hooks and what evidence you can provide for retention windows; please flag any gaps.
- We'll invite one architect and our security PM.

I'll add the calendar invite once you send it. Attaching a brief Nexus infra constraints doc for context.

Thanks,
Anika Patel
Technical Program Manager, GSI Partners
anika.patel@gsi-partners.io

- Draft the MAP with clear owners for SSO, logging, and billing hooks (I'll populate sections for SSO + logging).
- Coordinate with Marissa on product overview slides (Marissa will lead the marketplace-flow section).
- Prepare a 10–15 minute technical pre-read (1–2 slides) that we can attach to the calendar invite.

Marissa — can you confirm you'll cover the top-level listing flow and one slide of UX requirements?
Jonas — once you send the invite I will add Camila + Marissa as presenters and attach the pre-read + MAP.
